body:
This item has no clear verification objective. Please rephrase with “Verify that... “  and make it clearer as to what the objective is - could it be solved with anti-automation, rate limiting, API gateway, what? 

I think this has the wrong CWE - it’s anti-automation (CWE-799) rather than CWE 770.
title: V13.2.4 Is not in the standard format. What is we are verifying?
